indicators.question: Is 18 the minimum age for marriage, with no exceptions?
indicators.note: 21 for men and 18 for women; child marriages are voidable rather than void.

indicators.question: May a man take more than one wife?
indicators.note: Allowed for Muslims under personal law; banned for others, and in Uttarakhand under its 2024 civil code.

indicators.question: Can two people of different religions marry in the country?
indicators.note: Allowed under the Special Marriage Act, but several states’ anti-conversion laws target interfaith marriages.

indicators.question: Can a couple marry without a religious ceremony or authority?
Does an adult woman need a male guardian’s consent to marry?
Is the minimum marriage age the same for women and men?
Can both spouses divorce on equal terms?
Do daughters inherit equally with sons?
indicators.note: Hindu daughters gained equal rights in 2005; Muslim personal law applies to Muslims.

indicators.question: Does the law give at least 14 weeks of paid maternity leave (the ILO standard)?
Is hitting children banned in all settings, including the home?
Is adultery a crime?
indicators.note: Struck down by the Supreme Court in 2018.

indicators.question: Is sex between unmarried adults a crime?
Is it a crime for an unmarried couple to live together?
How does the law treat selling and buying sex between adults?
Is pornography legal for adults?
indicators.note: Production and distribution are illegal; private viewing is not.

indicators.question: Must women wear religious dress such as the hijab in public?
Is there a religious or morality police that can stop people in public?
Is rape within marriage a crime?
indicators.note: Exception 2 to section 63 of the 2023 penal code exempts husbands where the wife is over 18; challenged in the Supreme Court.

indicators.question: Does the law define rape as sex without consent, rather than requiring force?
indicators.note: Rape is defined as against her will or without consent, but with the marital exemption.

indicators.question: Can marrying the victim end a rape prosecution or sentence?
What is the heaviest sentence the law allows for rape?
indicators.note: Death for rape of a girl under 12 since 2018.

indicators.question: Does the law allow chemical castration of sex offenders?
Is there a law against sexual harassment at work?
Is sex between people of the same sex legal?
indicators.note: Decriminalised by the Supreme Court in 2018.

indicators.question: Can same-sex couples marry or form a legal union?
Can same-sex couples adopt jointly?
Does national law ban firing someone for their sexual orientation?
Does hate-crime law cover sexual orientation?
Can a trans person change their legal gender?
Are “conversion therapy” practices banned nationally?
Does the law restrict LGBT content, groups or Pride events?
Does a married woman need her husband’s permission to travel abroad or to work?
Does a woman’s testimony count the same as a man’s in court?
Can a mother pass her citizenship to her children on the same terms as a father?
Is there a specific law against domestic violence?
When is abortion legal?
Is contraception freely available?
Is killing a woman because she is a woman a separate crime?
Does the law reserve seats or set candidate quotas for women?
indicators.note: The 2023 Women’s Reservation Act takes effect after the next delimitation.

indicators.question: Has a woman been head of government or elected head of state?
Is insulting religion a crime?
Is there a penalty for leaving Islam or the state religion?
Is wearing a face veil such as the niqab or burqa banned in public?
Are headscarves banned for students or public servants?
Does the law limit minarets or mosque architecture?
Is slaughter without stunning, as in halal and kosher practice, banned?
Does citizenship or immigration law treat people differently by religion?
indicators.answer: Excludes a religion from a benefit
indicators.note: The 2019 Citizenship Amendment Act fast-tracks citizenship for Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi and Christian refugees from three neighbouring countries, not Muslims.

indicators.question: Does the state ban or criminalise a religious group?
Can opposition parties compete for power?
Has an opposition party won power at a national election since 2000?
Is the country ruled by a communist party?
Are communist parties or symbols banned?
Are Nazi or fascist parties or symbols banned?
Is Holocaust denial a crime?
Is insulting the head of state or ruler a crime?
Are major platforms such as Facebook, X, Instagram or YouTube blocked?
Can spreading “false information” lead to prison?
Is using unapproved VPNs restricted?
Has the government cut internet access in a region or nationwide since 2023?
indicators.note: The world’s most frequent shutdowns, mostly regional.

indicators.question: Does the law still allow the death penalty?
Has the country carried out executions in 2024–26?
Does the law allow judicial flogging or caning?
Can drug trafficking carry the death penalty?
Can adultery, same-sex relations or apostasy carry the death penalty?
Are mainstream dating apps such as Tinder and Bumble available?
Are gay dating apps such as Grindr blocked or removed from app stores?
Is sharing intimate images without consent (“revenge porn”) a crime?
Is making or sharing sexual deepfakes of a real person a crime?
Have security forces been documented using dating apps to arrest LGBT people?
Is recreational cannabis legal?
Is alcohol banned?
indicators.note: Banned in Gujarat, Bihar, Nagaland and Mizoram.

indicators.question: Is assisted dying or euthanasia legal?
Is military service compulsory?
Is attempting suicide a crime?
